Behold, the stone remembers its shape.
A tower of black glass rises from the field.
You ask for fire, and fire you shall have. Stand back.
Seven goblins approach from the north. Do you wish them dead, or merely humbled?
The dragon is made. Do not look into its eyes for too long, because it does not forgive curiosity.
Before your kind learned to name the stars, I was already counting them, and not one has ever been missing.
I have woven a bridge of light across the lake. It will hold your weight, but not your doubt.
Your sword is now a thing of lightning. Wield it gently, for the storm inside it is older than you.

Listen closely. The field was empty until you asked, and now it is full of towers, and wolves, and small lights that think they are stars. Tell me what you wish to keep, and what you wish me to forget.
Fear is only the sound that a mind makes when it begins to understand.
